program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmidn": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "Ln":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),
    "gmidp": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "Lp":    (0.6, 0.3, 2.0),
    "Rf":    (450e3, 415e3, 600e3),
    "Cb":    (40e-12, 10e-12, 80e-12),   # AC bypass of current-fed PMOS source node
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cpd = spec.get("cpd", 5e-13); cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-13)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I = iref                      # whole inverter stack runs on IREF (current reuse)
    Rf, Cb = p["Rf"], p["Cb"]

    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.6)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I, vds=m1.vgs)
    vout_dc = m1.vgs
    m2 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.6)

    n = Netlist("iin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "iin", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "iin", "ibias", "ibias", m2)   # pfet bulk = own source
    n.C("CB", "ibias", "vss", Cb)
    n.R("RF", "vout", "iin", Rf)

    f = np.logspace(3, 9, 6000); s = 2j * PI * f
    Zb = 1.0 / (s * Cb)
    gmp = m2.gm / (1.0 + (m2.gm + m2.gds) * Zb)       # source-degenerated by bypass node
    gdsp = m2.gds / (1.0 + (m2.gm + m2.gds) * Zb)
    gm = m1.gm + gmp
    Cin = cpd + m1.cgg + m2.cgg
    Cout = cl + m1.cdd + m2.cdd
    Cf = m1.cgd + m2.cgd
    Yf = 1.0 / Rf + s * Cf
    Av = -(gm - s * Cf) / (m1.gds + gdsp + s * Cout + Yf)
    Z = -Av / (s * Cin + Yf * (1 - Av))
    mag = np.abs(Z)
    z0 = mag[0]
    idx = np.where(mag < z0 / math.sqrt(2))[0]
    f3db = float(f[idx[0]]) if len(idx) else 1e9

    A0 = m1.gm / (m1.gds + 1.0 / Rf)
    zt = Rf * A0 / (1 + A0)

    kT = 1.38e-23 * 300.0
    w = 2 * PI * 1e6
    gmt = m1.gm + m2.gm
    iout2 = 4 * kT * 0.8 * gmt
    in2 = 4 * kT / Rf + iout2 / gmt**2 * ((1.0 / Rf)**2 + (w * (Cin + Cf))**2)
    in_noise = math.sqrt(in2) * 1.3          # margin for flicker

    power = 1.98 * I

    return n, {"zt_dbohm": db(zt), "f3db": f3db, "power": power,
               "vout_dc": vout_dc, "in_noise_1m": in_noise}
